full_prompt_en: The square image is a formal oil portrait of a young man seated frontally against a very dark patterned background. He occupies the centre from the head to the knees, with one pale yellow trouser leg crossing the lower-right foreground. His posture is upright but relaxed, and his serious face looks directly outward beneath neatly arranged dark hair. The skin is pale and softly modelled, with small highlights on the forehead, nose and cheek, while the eyes and hair remain strongly defined. A crisp white ruffled neckcloth sits high at the throat and spills over the front of a dark brown brocade waistcoat. The waistcoat carries a subtle repeating floral pattern and is fastened at the centre with small buttons. Over it, a deep teal-green coat opens across the torso, its broad lapels and sleeves shaped by cool shadows and narrow highlights. A row of round gold buttons descends along the front. A white lace cuff surrounds the visible wrist on the left side of the image, where a relaxed hand rests on the chair arm. The opposite teal sleeve extends toward the right edge, with the other hand outside the frame. The chair is upholstered in muted olive and gold fabric with a curved, patterned back visible around the shoulders and left side. Its dark carved frame blends into the surrounding background. Behind the sitter, the nearly black brown ground carries faint gold foliage-like ornament and a few indistinct vertical contours, without forming a clear room. The lower coat and pale breeches provide the strongest value contrast against the shadowed seat. Warm frontal light illuminates the face, neckcloth, visible hand and knee, while the background and chair edges sink into deep brown-black. Brushwork is controlled and fine in the features and lace, broader in the coat and chair. No text is visible. The sitter’s arms spread away from the torso, making a broad relaxed arrangement above the pale trouser leg. On the visible chair arm, the fingers curve down over the upholstery. The dark brocade remains visible in the opening between the coat fronts, where its subdued pattern contrasts with the smoother teal cloth. The framing feels close but includes enough of the chair and legs to establish a formal seated pose rather than a head study. The overall composition is balanced around the seated figure, with the teal coat and pale leg separating from the dark setting and the lace, brocade and gold fastenings adding restrained detail.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的正式油画肖像，一名年轻男子正面坐在深色纹样背景前。他从头部到膝部占据画面中央，一条浅黄色裤腿交叠在右下前景。他坐姿挺直却放松，神情严肃，整齐的深色头发下双眼直视观者。肤色浅，额头、鼻子与面颊有细小柔光，眼睛和发际则刻画清晰。颈间系着整洁的白色褶饰领巾，铺在深褐色暗纹锦缎背心前。背心带有细微重复花纹，中央以小纽扣扣合。外面穿一件深青绿色外套，衣襟在身前敞开，宽阔翻领和袖子以冷影与窄亮边塑形。一列金色圆扣沿衣襟向下排列。画面左侧可见的手腕外露出白色蕾丝袖口，放松的手搭在椅子扶手上。另一侧青绿衣袖伸向右边缘，那只手位于画框之外。椅子以低饱和橄榄金色织物包覆，肩后和左侧可见弧形纹样靠背，深色雕刻框架则融入周围背景。男子身后近乎黑褐色的底子带有淡淡金色叶饰般纹样和几道模糊竖向轮廓，但没有明确形成房间场景。外套下摆与浅色马裤在暗色座椅前构成最强明暗对比。暖色正面光照亮脸、领巾、可见的手和膝部，背景与椅子边缘则沉入深棕黑色。五官与蕾丝处笔触细致受控，外套和椅子使用较宽的笔触。画面中没有可见文字。男子双臂向躯干两侧展开，在浅色裤腿上方形成宽阔放松的姿态。可见扶手上的手指顺着软包边缘向下弯曲。外套敞开的前襟之间仍可见深色锦缎，其低调纹样与较平滑的青绿布料形成质感对比。画面取景虽然较近，但仍保留足够椅子和腿部，让坐姿显得正式，而不只是头部特写。整体构图围绕坐姿人物取得平衡，青绿外套与浅色裤腿从深色环境中凸显，蕾丝、锦缎和金色扣件增添克制细节。
style_prompt_en: The painting uses controlled tonal modelling, dark surroundings and selective warm illumination. Deep brown, black and muted green create a shadowed ground, while pale tonal passages and small gold accents provide measured contrast. Fine edges define delicate details; broader strokes describe larger surfaces without losing their form. Subtle ornament remains low in contrast and does not compete with the main light-dark structure. Highlights are concentrated rather than scattered, giving the image a composed, formal quality. The overall treatment balances precision, rich shadow and a restrained palette of cool greens, warm browns and soft ivory.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画采用受控的调性塑形、深色环境与选择性的暖光。深褐、黑色和低饱和绿构成阴影底色，浅色调区域与少量金色细节提供适度对比。精细边缘刻画细部，较宽笔触表现大面积表面而不损失形体。淡化的装饰纹样保持低反差，不与主要明暗结构争夺注意力。高光集中而非散布，使画面显得端庄凝练。整体处理在精确刻画、浓重阴影和冷绿、暖褐、柔象牙色的克制配色之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Seated young man in a teal coat and brocade waistcoat
theme_zh: 青绿外套与锦缎背心的青年坐像
name: John Singleton Copley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
